summary: A genuinely playable, original-IP endless-runner MVP with persistent accounts, progression, unlockable creatures and forms, and a global leaderboard.

questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The requested frontend stack is React, TypeScript, and Vite.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for a more reliable game client.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and tooling should be used?

options.label: React + Vite
options.description: Fast development tooling and a component-based game interface.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a different frontend framework or tooling.

questions.question: What frontend features should the MVP include?
questions.answer: Playable three-lane endless runner with keyboard and swipe controls; account screens; game HUD and results; creature selection, progression and unlocks; global leaderboard; responsive accessible UI.
questions.rationale: Derived from the confirmed game and account requirements; responsive browser play is a sensible MVP default.
questions.recommendedChoice: Playable three-lane endless runner with keyboard and swipe controls; account screens; game HUD and results; creature selection, progression and unlocks; global leaderboard; responsive accessible UI.

questions.question: Which language should the backend use?
questions.rationale: The requested backend stack and shared contracts use TypeScript.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for the API and shared contracts.

questions.question: Which backend framework and runtime should be used?
What backend features should the MVP include?
questions.answer: Shared typed contracts; persistent username/password accounts without email or automated password recovery; persistent profile, progress, coin balance, creature/form unlocks and scores; validated score submission and global rankings; no microtransactions; the game remains free to play and any future support is through optional external donations without in-game benefits.
questions.rationale: Captures the confirmed account, progression, ranking, and monetization requirements.
questions.recommendedChoice: Shared typed contracts; persistent username/password accounts without email or automated password recovery; persistent profile, progress, coin balance, creature/form unlocks and scores; validated score submission and global rankings; no microtransactions; the game remains free to play and any future support is through optional external donations without in-game benefits.

questions.question: Which data stores does the MVP require?
questions.rationale: Persistent accounts, game progress, unlocks, and global scores require a relational database; no user-uploaded media is required.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not need persistent data storage.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Relational storage for accounts, profiles, progression, and scores.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Object storage for uploaded or served files and media.

questions.question: Will users sign in to use application API features?
questions.rationale: Persistent username/password accounts and per-user progress are confirmed requirements.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate to access their persistent game profile and progress.

options.label: No
options.description: The app has no signed-in API features.
